audit.whatIsWrong: Level 1 was 'Skill' and Levels 2, 3 and First item were given to Warwick, contradicting the packet chart and the page's own why-strings, which say Level 1 belongs to Warwick and that Kled owns 2 through 5 and first item.
audit.why: Warwick's Eternal Hunger and Jaws of the Beast healing win the pokeless Level 1; Kled's W and E-W-E win 2-5; Warwick reclaims it at two-plus items on sustain.
audit.corrected: Row 1 to Warwick; rows 2, 3, 4-5 and First item to Kled; Level 6 stays Skill; 2+ items stays Warwick.

audit.why: Kled: W at 2, full pattern at 3, Eclipse. Warwick: level 6 (Infinite Duress 110/90/70s), Blood Hunt rank-ups (80s down to 40s), and two-plus items of lifesteal.

audit.whatIsWrong: None of Warwick's abilities were named anywhere in the full layer (packet defect), and Primal Howl (E) — the ability that actually breaks Kled's W burst — is absent from the entire page.
audit.why: Primal Howl is 15/14/13/12/11s: 2.5s of damage reduction, then a 1s flee on expiry or recast. That fear interrupts Kled's four W attacks and his E recast mid-combo, and the damage reduction blunts the burst before it. Infinite Duress is a 1.5s suppression and a channel, so CC from an ally breaks it early. Jaws of the Beast deals damage based on max health, so stacking raw armour is the wrong answer — Grievous Wounds is.
audit.corrected: Primal Howl, Jaws of the Beast, Blood Hunt and Infinite Duress named with cooldowns in the interaction, cooldown and don't fields.

audit.whatIsWrong: Anti-heal is named as an item but never as a timing, and armour is implied to be the answer to his damage.
audit.why: Jaws of the Beast is max-health damage that armour does not reduce meaningfully, and Eternal Hunger triples its healing below 25% health — the exact window Kled's all-ins create.

edits.before: - Warwick Infinite Duress: matchup-defining — His all-in lock. Q-pull or dodge it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Infinite Duress (R), 110/90/70s: 1.5s suppression and a channel — an ally's CC breaks it. - Primal Howl (E), 11-15s: 2.5s damage reduction, then a 1s flee that cuts your W attacks short. - Jaws of the Beast (Q), 6-8s: max-health damage, so armour is not the answer.

edits.before: Track Warwick's Infinite Duress: His all-in lock. Q-pull or dodge it. When it is down — Q-pull + W him.
edits.after: Infinite Duress (R) suppresses 1.5s and is a channel an ally can break. Primal Howl (E), 11-15s, reduces damage then fears for 1s — it is what cuts your W short, so bait it before you dump attacks.

edits.before: His all-in lock. Q-pull or dodge it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: 1.5s suppression on a 70-110s cooldown. Commit inside that gap, not before it.

edits.before: Beartrap Warwick when his answer is down, rip the full mounted combo, and if dismounted, kite for courage and remount mid-fight.
edits.after: Jaws of the Beast is max-health damage, so armour does nothing — buy Grievous Wounds instead, and apply it before you push him under 25%, where Eternal Hunger triples his healing.

edits.before: That is Warwick's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: Below 50% health his passive heals him on every auto, and below 25% that healing triples.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: 1.5s suppressed is your whole combo gone — hold E to dash out the instant he leaps.

notes: Chart rows 1, 2, 3, 4-5 and First item disagreed with the packet and the page's own why-strings; flipped as matched pairs. Packet defect confirmed: no Warwick ability was named in the full layer. Primal Howl (E) was missing from the entire page despite being the ability that interrupts Kled's W burst — now added. Whether the Primal Howl flee is cleansable or whether tenacity shortens it is not in the kit data and is not asserted.
